notes.title: Blast, Ram, Upgrade | Rising Heat Launches October 14!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="ACp8Nl1SdQA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]🚨 [b]Bullet Hell Roguelike Sickos, Assemble![/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Rising Heat[/b] just dropped a brand new [b]release date trailer[/b] at Gamescom, and it’s bringing the heat. Launching [b]October 14, 2025[/b]![/h3][p]This is your official call to ram through alien swarms, fuse broken builds, and [b]fight for survival in the galaxy’s deadliest gladiator arena[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]From solo developer [b][url="https://x.com/SirRodneyLuck"]Ronnie Lusso[/url][/b], backed by Apogee Entertainment, [i]Rising Heat[/i] is a passion project powered by speed, momentum, and chaos:[/p][p][/p][quote][p]“This is the game I’ve always wanted to play. Easy to learn, hard to put down. I hope Rising Heat pulls you in and keeps you coming back for more.”[/p][/quote][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44999925/96ded2f5d89464cb820cdd20a0cda3005c5b518f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]🎮 [b]Play the New Steam Demo Now![/b][/p][p]Test your piloting skills with [b]momentum-based flight[/b], a [b]tackle system[/b] that lets you smash through hordes, and a deep [b]loadout system[/b] full of hacks you can [b]upgrade, integrate, and fuse[/b] to break the game in the best way possible.[/p][p][/p][p]Want more destruction? Go [b]co-op[/b], where your ship is tethered to your partner’s by a supercharged beam. Just try not to get each other killed.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44999925/a8dc59e4649a6042e5bb6edbd0e29c7991a88498.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🔥 Key Features:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Do a Barrel Roll![/b] – Momentum-based combat lets you tackle enemies and chain through chaos.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customize Your Loadout[/b] – Fuse hacks, juggle stats, and craft the perfect build every run.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Plan Your Approach[/b] – Choose your pilot, ship, and upgrades before each run.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fly With a Friend[/b] – In co-op, your ships are linked. Synergy is survival.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44999925/fe46ccf37664c5d3b609831a473aae1709eb8f96.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]
🚨 [b]Join the Heat![/b][/h3][p]Want the latest Rising Heat updates, patch news, contests, or to talk shop about your broken builds?[/p][p]🔥 Join the [url="https://apo.gg/RHdiscord"][b]Rising Heat Discord[/b][/url] and be part of the squad.[/p][p]🐦 Follow [url="https://twitter.com/PlayRisingHeat"][b]@PlayRisingHeat[/b][/url] and [url="https://twitter.com/Apogee_Ent"][b]@Apogee_Ent[/b][/url] on X for trailers, chaos, and community spotlights![/p][p][/p][p]The swarm isn’t going to survive itself. See you in the arena, pilot. 💥🚀

📅 [b]Rising Heat launches October 14 on Steam[/b][/p][p]🛒 [b]Wishlist now and play the demo today!

[/b][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184290/Rising_Heat/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Rising Heat aims to be a next evolution of horde survival twin-stick shooters
notes.notes:
A sprinkle of Geometry Wars and other twin-stick shooters, a dash of Vampire Survivors styled upgrades - Rising Heat thinks it's going to be special.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/08/rising-heat-aims-to-be-a-next-evolution-of-horde-survival-twin-stick-shooters/

notes.title: 🚀🔥 NEW Steam Next Fest Co-Op Demo – Try Rising Heat Now!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=ACLvNN-klA0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]🚀 Rising Heat Unleashes an Upgraded Steam Next Fest Demo![/h3]

The ultimate space roguelike horde survival just got even better! Apogee Entertainment and Fuzzy Sock Studios are bringing a new and improved demo of Rising Heat to Steam Next Fest (Feb. 24 - March 1). Featuring co-op gameplay, expanded upgrades, and refined mechanics, this latest version lets you tackle the chaos solo or with a friend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44999925/4bb5a846fd06e57c534c64adfd1cf39561dd6964.gif[/img]

[h3]🔥 What’s New in the Demo?[/h3]
	•	[b]Momentum-Based Combat[/b] – Ram into enemies at high speed, chaining devastating tackles through swarms of robotic foes.
	•	[b]Strategic Upgrades & Synergies[/b] – Experiment with 60+ ship hacks, fuse upgrades, and create powerful builds every run.
	•	[b]Co-Op Action[/b] – Team up with a friend! A deadly energy tether links your ships—use it wisely, or it might be your downfall.
	•	[b]Massive Boss Battles[/b] – Take on multi-stage bosses with evolving attack patterns that push your skills to the limit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44999925/a4d8666cf161bae87967159e4774156cf70bc613.gif[/img]


[h3]🚀 Show Off Your Best Rising Heat Clips & Win! 🔥[/h3]
Think you’ve built the ultimate ship? Pulled off an insane combo? We want to see it!

Starting Day 3 of Steam Next Fest (February 26th), we’re holding a Rising Heat Clip & Build Challenge! Share your best gameplay clip, wildest build, or most jaw-dropping screenshot for a chance to win a FREE game key when Rising Heat launches!

🏆 How to Enter:
1️⃣ Play the Rising Heat Steam Next Fest Demo (Feb. 24 - March 1).
2️⃣ Post your best clip, build, or screenshot on [url=https://x.com/PlayRisingHeat]Twitter/X[/url] with #PlayRisingHeat and tag [url=https://x.com/PlayRisingHeat]@PlayRisingHeat[/url].
3️⃣ Our team will pick our 3 favorites, and winners will receive a free launch key!

🔥 Break the game. Show off your wildest synergies. Flex your most devastating builds. We’ll be keeping an eye on submissions all week—so let’s see what you’ve got!

Stay updated by following [url=https://x.com/PlayRisingHeat]@PlayRisingHeat[/url] and [url=https://x.com/Apogee_Ent]@Apogee_Ent[/url] on Twitter/X and joining the [url=https://apo.gg/RHdiscord]Rising Heat[/url] and [url=https://apo.gg/Discord]Apogee Entertainment Discord[/url] communities.

Get ready to FLING YOURSELF INTO DANGER! 🚀🔥
